name: Bone & Claret
idea: Claret engraving on bone paper with one gold hairline and nothing else.
tagline: Oxblood engraving, bone paper, one gold rule

defaults.intro: With the blessings of our families, we invite you to the wedding of

name: Lily & Bells
idea: A single hairline arch over midnight-navy type on ivory, the way a church door frames a couple.
tagline: An ivory arch for a church wedding

defaults.intro: Mr and Mrs Varghese invite you to the marriage of their daughter

name: Kasavu Gold
idea: A woven kasavu band of gold threads top and bottom, sindoor maroon names on uncoated cream.
tagline: Kerala kasavu, gold thread and deep red

defaults.intro: Together with our families we invite you to the wedding of

name: Chalk Graphite
idea: A letterhead, not a party: slate on cool chalk, left rail, no ornament but one 52px bar.
tagline: Cool chalk and slate, set like a letterhead

defaults.intro: After four years and one very long final term, we would like you there
defaults.subtitle: graduates in law
defaults.venue: Senate House, University of Madras, Chennai

name: Gallery White
idea: One enormous hairline name across the full measure on gallery white, and two thirds of the sheet left empty.
tagline: A private-view card: one name, enormous

defaults.intro: We are getting married next spring, and we would like you there

name: Oyster Panel
idea: A sheet of bronze-ruled oyster paper lying on a slightly darker ground, like a card on a table.
tagline: A ruled card resting on warm beige

defaults.intro: Two families would like you with them on the morning the promise is made

name: Sindoor Band
idea: One oxblood band straight through the middle of the frame with the names reversed out of it in marigold gold.
tagline: Names reversed out of an oxblood band

defaults.intro: The evening after the wedding, with everybody we love in one room

name: Umber Dusk
idea: The photograph is the design: warm umber dusk, a bronze crescent, and type held to the lower third.
tagline: A photograph at dusk, bronze crescent

defaults.intro: Bismillah. We invite you to the nikah of our children

name: Muhurtham Sindoor
idea: The most ornate genre at its quietest: one mandala struck in marigold gold on the names' own axis, a scalloped hairline, and nothing else on the oxblood sheet.
tagline: Oxblood and marigold gold, struck for a muhurtham

defaults.intro: The muhurtham is at half past ten and it will not wait, so come in time to see them tie the thaali
defaults.venue: Ananthapuri Kalyana Mandapam, East Fort, Thiruvananthapuram
defaults.closing: With the blessings of both tharavads

name: Kalpathy Arch
idea: One cocoa hairline arch standing for the temple doorway, drawn on turmeric-washed sandal paper with no metal anywhere.
tagline: A mandapam doorway in cocoa on turmeric paper

defaults.intro: Our daughter will be married at the Kalpathy temple as the sun comes up over the agraharam
defaults.venue: Sree Visalakshi Sametha Viswanatha Swamy Temple, Kalpathy
defaults.closing: Our elders will be glad to see you

name: Onam Peacock
idea: The kasavu border moved off the mundu and onto a Mysore peacock-teal card: gold woven bands top and bottom, a lotus alone between them.
tagline: Gold kasavu bands on Mysore peacock teal

defaults.intro: The sadya is at noon on Thiruvonam, served on plantain leaves, and there is a place kept for you
defaults.subtitle: twenty-six at one table

name: Dawn Letterhead
idea: A gruhapravesham set as a letterhead: the house's own name large on warm chalk, one bronze bar, and the house itself as the only mark.
tagline: A house name set like a letterhead

defaults.intro: Thirty years of saving, and the house finally has a name. We would like you in it on the first morning
defaults.subtitle: first light, first pooja

name: Clay Lotus
idea: A first-rice card on a dusty terracotta sheet lying on a darker ground, warm and slightly wonky, with one lotus and no pastel.
tagline: A first-rice card in dusty terracotta pink

defaults.intro: Our daughter takes her first mouthful of rice this Thulam, and we would like you at the temple that morning
defaults.subtitle: her first rice

name: Kumbakonam Patrikai
idea: A letterpress patrikai: one black band straight through a bone card with the names reversed out of it, ruled above and below in kumkumam red.
tagline: Bone, a black band, one kumkumam rule

defaults.intro: The panchangam has been read and the hour fixed. Both houses ask you to be there when it comes

name: Smoke & Sun
idea: Sixty years marked once: a single sun in champagne gold above the name, on smoked charcoal that deepens towards the foot of the card.
tagline: Smoked charcoal and champagne gold for sixty years

defaults.intro: Sixty years, and he has never once asked for a party. We are having one anyway, and it is not complete without you
defaults.subtitle: sixty years, one quiet man
defaults.closing: He will pretend he did not want this

name: Peacock Mihrab
idea: A single aged-gold mihrab arch on Mysore teal, a crescent at its crown, and both spandrels left empty.
tagline: A gold mihrab arch on Mysore teal

defaults.intro: By the grace of Allah the date is fixed, and both families, Kozhikode and Vadakara, hope to see you at the nikah

name: Graphite Arch
idea: A church arch drawn in graphite on oyster paper, with a plain Latin cross at the keystone and no metal anywhere.
tagline: A graphite church arch with no metal anywhere

defaults.intro: We were betrothed at home in December. The marriage is in January at half past nine, and the church is big enough for everybody
defaults.closing: Pray with us, then eat with us

name: Smoke & Champagne
idea: A champagne-gold card floating on smoked charcoal, cut for the walima dinner and nothing before it.
tagline: A champagne card laid on smoked charcoal

defaults.intro: Our nikah is done, alhamdulillah. Now come and eat with us
defaults.closing: Bismillah, and welcome to our table

name: Shell Dove
idea: A christening done in bitter umber on warm shell, soft without a grain of sugar.
tagline: Bitter umber on warm shell, a christening

defaults.intro: We are bringing our daughter to be baptised on the second Sunday of January, and we would like you at the font
defaults.subtitle: our daughter, baptised

name: Vesper Press
idea: An evening wedding with no gold in it at all: one enormous bone name on near-black, a pewter hairline, and two thirds of the sheet left dark.
tagline: Bone and pewter on near-black, no gold

defaults.intro: A six o'clock blessing at San Thome, dinner at the club afterwards, and the two of us hoping you can come
defaults.closing: In His light, and in good company

name: Jubilee Band
idea: A silver-jubilee Mass given the heaviest shape in the library: one Marian-blue band with the names reversed out of it.
tagline: A silver-jubilee Mass, the names reversed out

defaults.intro: Twenty-five years this January, and a Mass of thanksgiving at the church where it all started

name: Private View
idea: A gallery's private-view card: the title of the show set enormous in Didone on near-black stock, with two thirds of the sheet left dark and empty.
tagline: Near-black stock, one Didone line, nothing else

defaults.intro: The gallery is ours for one evening before the city is let in. Drinks downstairs, the painter upstairs.
defaults.subtitle: paintings by Rukmini Das

name: Naming Day
idea: A child's name set as large as an exhibition title, in chalk blue and ultramarine with one lotus, instead of nursery pastel.
tagline: A child's name set as large as a title

defaults.intro: She has a name at last, and we would like you in the room when we say it out loud for the first time.
defaults.subtitle: born the fourth of April

name: Press Room
idea: A newsroom farewell set as a memo: graphite on paper white, flush to a left rail, one quill and one short bar.
tagline: A newsroom farewell, set like a memo

defaults.intro: Thirty-one years on the desk, four of them running it. One evening to say so properly, and then he is off.
defaults.subtitle: leaves the news desk

name: Vermilion Rail
idea: A city wedding announced the way a restaurant booking is: old-style names flush left with one vermilion bar and no frame anywhere.
tagline: Bone paper, one red bar, flush left

defaults.intro: We are signing the register at eleven and eating at one. Thirty people, one long table, no procession.
defaults.closing: With love, from both our houses

name: Slate Band
idea: A fortieth reduced to one slate band straight through the middle of the sheet with the name reversed out of it.
tagline: One slate band, the name knocked out

defaults.intro: A room upstairs, forty people I actually want there, and a playlist I have been building since March.
defaults.subtitle: forty, and glad of it

name: Laurel Hall
idea: A convocation in inscriptional capitals on dry sage with a single laurel, refusing the navy and gold every other degree card uses.
tagline: Inscriptional capitals on dry sage, one laurel

defaults.intro: Six years, two cities and a thesis nobody will read. Come and watch the hood go on.
defaults.subtitle: master of architecture
defaults.closing: Lunch after, if it stays dry

name: Charcoal Chandelier
idea: A single champagne chandelier hung inside a beaded hairline on flat smoked charcoal, the rest of the sheet left dark and empty.
tagline: Champagne gold on smoked charcoal, for the dinner

defaults.intro: The morning is for the families. The evening is for everyone, and we would like you at the table
defaults.venue: Crystal Ballroom, Taj West End, Bengaluru

name: Peacock Arch
idea: An aged-gold hairline arch on Mysore peacock teal, standing in for the mandapam doorway at lamp-lighting hour.
tagline: An aged-gold arch on Mysore peacock teal

defaults.intro: The lamps go up at dusk and the nadaswaram starts soon after; we would be glad of you in the mantapa
defaults.closing: With the blessings of both our homes

name: Aubergine Henna
idea: The mehndi photograph is the whole design, held under one rose-gold filigree on Kanchipuram aubergine, every word kept to the lower third.
tagline: A henna night, rose gold over aubergine dark

defaults.intro: Henna, a dholki and far too much food, the night before the wedding
defaults.closing: Wear something you can dance in

name: Marigold Kasavu
idea: The kasavu band rewoven in marigold gold on an oxblood ground, for the half of the wedding that happens after dark.
tagline: Marigold kasavu threads across an oxblood evening

defaults.intro: The muhurtham is at dawn; the sadya and the music are at night, and that is the half we want you for

name: Umber Rail
idea: A warm-wood letterhead for a fortieth: the name large on a left rail, one bronze bar, one candle, no decoration.
tagline: A wood-dark letterhead for a fortieth dinner

defaults.intro: No speeches and no surprises - one long table, late food, and the people I actually like
defaults.subtitle: turns forty
defaults.closing: Dinner at eight, nothing to carry

name: Oyster Crest
idea: A wedding card with no metal in it at all — a graphite crest engraved on laid oyster, the sheet floating one shade above its own ground.
tagline: Graphite crest on laid oyster, no metal anywhere

defaults.intro: The Fernandes family asks you to the nuptial Mass for their daughter, and to the long lunch that follows at the house
defaults.venue: Our Lady of Miracles Church, Milagres, Mangaluru

name: Claret Monogram
idea: One gold monogram, no frame at all, and claret ink spent on the two names and nothing else.
tagline: One gold monogram, claret names, no frame

defaults.intro: Both houses have settled the muhurtham, and ask you to be seated well before the mangalyam is tied
defaults.venue: Sri Parthasarathy Kalyana Mandapam, Mylapore, Chennai
defaults.closing: Blessed by the elders of both houses

name: Midnight Correspondence
idea: A visiting card enlarged until it fills the sheet: inscriptional navy letterforms, four brass corners, one small diamond and no second mark.
tagline: Navy letterforms, brass corners, one small diamond

defaults.intro: They were married quietly that morning; the evening belongs to everyone, in the ballroom, from half past seven
defaults.venue: The Ballroom, Taj Mahal Palace, Apollo Bunder, Mumbai

name: Chalk Copperplate
idea: Both names written in one unbroken copperplate line on warm chalk, with a bronze filigree no bigger than a thumbnail.
tagline: Copperplate names on warm chalk, bronze filigree

defaults.intro: Twenty-five years in the same house, and the children would like one evening made of it
defaults.closing: Twenty-five years, and the same two chairs

name: Smoked Champagne
idea: Fifty years dressed for evening: on smoked charcoal, a champagne wreath and one beaded hairline are the only light on the sheet.
tagline: Champagne wreath on smoked charcoal, evening dress

defaults.intro: Fifty years this October, and their children ask you to dinner, black tie, under the lights on the lawn
defaults.venue: Rose Garden Lawn, Kodaikanal Club, Kodaikanal
defaults.closing: Fifty years, and still at home to you

name: One Candle
idea: A first birthday on a left rail with a single hairline candle for the single year, and not one balloon on the sheet.
tagline: One candle for one year, no balloons

defaults.intro: Ira is one on Sunday, and there will be far more cake than people
defaults.subtitle: one whole year
defaults.closing: Come and make a fuss of her

name: Sage Doorway
idea: A gruhapravesham given the arch it deserves: one sage hairline doorway over the house's own name, with mango leaves closing the card.
tagline: A hairline arch for a new front door

defaults.intro: The paint is dry and the kitchen works, so the house would like some noise in it
defaults.subtitle: our new house
defaults.closing: Our new door is open to you

name: Chalk Blue Cradle
idea: A cradle ceremony as a chalk-blue sheet lying on a darker one, with a single ultramarine rattle at its head and no nursery pastel anywhere.
tagline: Ultramarine rattle on a chalk blue sheet

defaults.intro: The cradle goes up on Thursday morning, and we would like the house full
defaults.subtitle: three weeks old

name: Pongal Ochre
idea: A Thai Pongal card the colour of the pot: ochre bands woven top and bottom of turmeric paper, with the sun alone on the sheet between them.
tagline: Ochre bands and the Pongal sun

defaults.intro: The pot goes on at first light and the sugarcane is already standing in the corner
defaults.subtitle: the pot boils at sunrise

name: Oyster Emeritus
idea: A retirement given a gallery card instead of a party: the teacher's name alone across the full measure of warm chalk, thirty-one years the only other line.
tagline: A teacher's name alone on warm chalk

defaults.intro: Thirty-one years of other people's children, and now a free Monday morning
defaults.subtitle: retires from teaching
defaults.venue: Ammu Nivas, 8 Thevara Ferry Road, Kochi

name: Shell & Copper
idea: Forty years of marriage reversed out of one deep umber band, with a rose-copper foil hairline above and below it and nothing else on the sheet.
tagline: Forty years knocked out of an umber band

defaults.intro: Forty years in the same house, four grandchildren, and the same two chairs on the veranda
defaults.closing: With love from both of us

name: Maghrib Crescent
idea: An iftar put on a burnt-wood ground because the fast breaks after dark, with the hour of maghrib as the only number and one copper crescent above it.
tagline: Dusk ground, one copper crescent, the hour of maghrib

defaults.intro: We break the fast at six forty, and there is more than enough for everybody
defaults.subtitle: on the twenty-third night
